verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents creating a feature from the dashboard and toggling flags per environment without deploying new code. That covers creating a flag and switching it live in production. The 'within minutes of signing up' part is not shown: there is no documented quickstart or signup flow and no hands-on time-to-first-toggle report. Missing for 10: documented signup-to-first-flag onboarding path, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-value.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Go to the **Features** section in your dashboard. Click **Create Feature**.
Enter a descriptive name for your flag (e.g., new_ui_enabled).
Easily toggle individual features on and off, and make changes without deploying new code
use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments.
